name: Education Fee reimbursement for open category students affected due to SEBC and EWS reservation in medical and Dental colleges
description: The scheme provides course fee reimbursement for students applying for MBBS,BDS, Post Graduate Medical (MD/MS) in Private un-aided colleges. Beneficiary Category: OPEN Eligible Courses: Eligible Courses: MBBS, BDS, Post Graduate Medical (MD/MS) in Private un-aided colleges.

evidence.quote: 1. Applicant should belong to Open category. (Total 112 applicants are going to take benefit of this scheme)

criteria.label: 2. Applicant should have taken admission through CAP.

evidence.quote: 2. Applicant should have taken admission through CAP.

criteria.label: 3. No scholarship for Management Quota Admission.

evidence.quote: 3. No scholarship for Management Quota Admission.

criteria.label: 4. No Income criteria check for this scheme.

evidence.quote: 4. No Income criteria check for this scheme.
5. Applicant should be domicile of Maharashtra.

criteria.label: 6. Deemed university students are not applicable for this scheme.

evidence.quote: 6. Deemed university students are not applicable for this scheme.

criteria.label: 7. Applicant should not have gap of 2 or more than 2 year in course duration.

evidence.quote: 7. Applicant should not have gap of 2 or more than 2 year in course duration.

criteria.label: 9. Failure in academic year, misconduct, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible.

evidence.quote: 9. Failure in academic year, misconduct, not fulfilling attendance criteria if found then candidate will not be eligible.

benefits.text: Benefit Amount = Institute FRA approved fee (Private) – Government Institute approved fee will be provided.

evidence.quote: Benefit Amount = Institute FRA approved fee (Private) – Government Institute approved fee will be provided.

documents.name: 2. New applicants need to submit HSC and SSC marksheet

evidence.quote: 2. New applicants need to submit HSC and SSC marksheet

renewal:
1. The student have to pass the previous year examination. ATKT will be allowed.
2. 50 % Attendance is mandatory for renewal.
applicationProcess: For Academic Year 2026-27, apply on the MahaDBT 2.0 portal (fresh and renewal applications). The scheme page on MahaDBT 1.0 remains the information source.

applicationUrlEvidence.quote: Fresh and renewal applications for the Academic Year 2026-27 will be accepted only through the MahaDBT 2.0 Portal.
